records.title: Biphasic Electrostimulation Artifact Model for ECAP Extraction in Spinal Cord Stimulation

decisions.notes: Two SCS participants and no independent cohort or participant-disjoint validation. Eq. 11 and results captions define a harmonic-mean E-score, while Appendix C refers to a geometric mean; the metric actually used for reported values cannot be resolved from text alone. Artifact extraction quality is not pain intensity, analgesic response or cross-patient performance.

updates.метод: Biphasic electrostimulation artifact model based on additivity and boundary conditions; piecewise-linear ECAP growth-curve fit (Eqs. 8-9) evaluated with the E-score defined in Eq. 11 as harmonic mean of denoising and fidelity rates.
